description: The techniques nearest in meaning to `query` (English works best: what the effect looks like or what it is for, such as "text that rises out of a blur" or "a glitch transition between scenes"), best first, with `score` (cosine similarity, 1 is the same). Each has its id, name, kind, description, when to use it, its libraries, the runtime and template of its recipe, the second of the recipe's video it is seen best in, a link to the recipe and to that frame. No code: read it with get_technique.
